title: Every Token Leaves a Ripple in the Stream of Thought: Eliciting Model-Internal Token Saliency for Chain-of-Thought Compression
abstract: arXiv:2608.31066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves multi-step problem solving, but long reasoning traces inflate inference cost. Token-level CoT compression reduces this cost by pruning full reasoning chains into shorter traces for model adaptation, making token selection the central challenge. Existing methods often rely on external scorers or heuristic signals only indirectly tied to the model's internal answer computation. We instead adopt a model-internal perspective: as the model forms an answer, each reasoning token leaves a ripple in the residual stream, the model's \emph{stream of thought}, and the magnitude of this ripple reflects the token's contribution to the answer computation. translated_title: 每个Token都在思维流中留下涟漪：引出模型内部的Token显著性用于思维链压缩
translated_abstract: 思维链推理提升了多步问题求解的能力，但冗长的推理轨迹会推高推理成本。Token级别的思维链压缩通过将完整推理链剪枝为更短的轨迹以用于模型适配，从而降低这一成本，这使得Token选择成为核心挑战。现有方法通常依赖外部打分器，或仅使用与模型内部答案计算间接相关的启发式信号。我们转而采用模型内部的视角：当模型形成答案时，每个推理Token都会在残差流——即模型的“思维流”——中留下涟漪，该涟漪的幅度反映了该Token对答案计算的贡献。基于这一观点，我们提出MIST（用于Token级思维链压缩的模型内部显著性方法），它沿两个互补的维度定义Token的重要性：必要性，即当某个Token的内部贡献被移除时答案似然的下降幅度……
tldr: 提出MIST方法，通过观察每个推理Token在模型残差流（思维流）中留下的“涟漪”幅度来衡量其对答案计算的内在贡献，从而无需外部打分器即可实现Token级的思维链压缩。
en_tdlr: Proposes MIST, which measures each reasoning token's contribution to answer computation via the ripple it leaves in the model's residual stream (stream of thought), enabling token-level chain-of-thought compression without external scorers.
